mapper.select: SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.title, u.username AS trainerName, t.average_rating, t.trainee_count, t.price, t.thumbnail_url, t.level, t.category FROM trainings t JOIN users u ON t.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE t.approval_status = '승인' AND t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
